jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description: This position is NOT remote; it is fully in-office. Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process if you are selected to move forward following the application review. U.S. Work Authorization Requirement King Aerospace, Inc. is not currently able to provide employment-based visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship. POSITION DESCRIPTION Job Title: Data Analyst Reports To: Information Technology Manager FLSA Status: Exempt Department: Administration Location: Addison, TX (KA-DAL); travel to other King Aerospace sites as needed POSITION SUMMARY The Data Analyst is responsible for collecting, transforming, analyzing, and reporting company data to support informed decision making across King Aerospace’s operations, programs, and support functions. This position designs and maintains Power BI dashboards and key performance metrics for company leadership, develops automated data pipelines that replace manual and spreadsheet-based reporting, and leads process improvement initiatives that increase efficiency across departments and sites. The Data Analyst supports the company’s program tracking, enterprise resource planning (ERP), and business systems initiatives, and works within a regulated defense and aerospace environment where controlled and export-controlled data must be protected in accordance with government and customer requirements. The Data Analyst is based at the Addison, Texas facility and travels to other King Aerospace locations as needed. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Design, develop, publish, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports in the Microsoft 365 GCC High environment for company leadership, program managers, and site general managers. Develop, maintain, and report on core operational metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs) for operations, production, quality, finance, and support functions in coordination with department leaders. Gather, clean, transform, and validate data from company systems, including maintenance and production systems, ERP, Microsoft 365 and SharePoint, helpdesk, and other operational sources. Build and maintain data models, Power Query transformations, and DAX measures; ensure the accuracy, consistency, and performance of reports and datasets. Develop and maintain automated data pipelines and integrations using APIs, dataflows, and scheduled refreshes to replace manual and spreadsheet-based reporting. Administer, configure, and maintain Monday.com workspaces, boards, workflows, automations, dashboards, and user access used for program tracking; support Monday.com users across departments and sites. Develop integrations between Monday.com and Power BI using the Monday.com API to support program status, schedule, and performance reporting. Lead the transition of program tracking from Monday.com to company-managed solutions, including extraction, validation, and archival of historical Monday.com data into a permanent internal repository. Ensure continuity of program tracking during the transition from Monday.com, maintaining equivalent functionality, reporting, and user access in the replacement solution. Design and support program tracking and reporting solutions for current and upcoming aircraft maintenance, modification, and government contract programs. Support the company’s ERP implementation by mapping departmental workflows, defining reporting requirements, supporting data migration and validation, and building analytics for the new system. Analyze business processes across departments and sites to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement. Document current-state and future-state processes, including process maps, workflow diagrams, and standard operating procedures. Recommend, plan, and facilitate process improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, or similar methodologies; track and report on results. Perform trend, variance, and root cause analysis on operational data such as labor hours, turn times, schedule performance, and cost. Perform ad hoc analysis and prepare reports, summaries, and presentations for leadership to support business decisions. Establish and maintain data quality standards, data definitions, and a data dictionary; identify and resolve data integrity issues with system owners. Manage Power BI workspaces, apps, dataset refresh schedules, and report access permissions in coordination with the IT department. Handle Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), export-controlled (ITAR), and proprietary customer data in accordance with company policies and NIST SP 800-171, CMMC, and DFARS requirements; ensure reports and datasets are restricted to authorized users. Use analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence (AI) tools only within approved, compliant environments, in accordance with the company’s Information Security, Acceptable Use, and AI Use Policies. Support the preparation of data, metrics, and evidence for customer, government, and internal reviews and audits. Partner with department managers and site leadership to translate business questions into reporting and analysis requirements. Train and support end users on dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics tools; develop user guides and training materials. Evaluate and recommend new analytics, reporting, and automation tools, subject to company review and approval. Maintain documentation for data sources, data models, reports, and pipelines. Travel to other company locations, as needed, to meet with stakeholders, observe operations, and support process improvement initiatives. Perform other related duties as assigned. QUALIFICATIONS The requirements below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Statistics, or a related field preferred, or three (3) years of data analysis or business intelligence experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Experience administering, building, or reporting from Monday.com strongly preferred. Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) or a similar business intelligence certification preferred. Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or other process improvement training or certification preferred. Experience in an aviation maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO), manufacturing, or defense contractor environment preferred. Experience with ERP system data, reporting, or implementation preferred. COMMUNICATION SKILLS Ability to read, analyze, and interpret business reports, technical documentation, and governmental regulations; write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals; translate complex data and analysis into clear findings and recommendations for non-technical audiences; and effectively present information and respond to questions from executives, managers, customers, and employees. MATHEMATICAL SKILLS Ability to apply concepts of descriptive and inferential statistics, probability, forecasting, and trend analysis, and to apply fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations. REASONING AND PROBLEM-SOLVING SKILLS Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, draw valid conclusions, and interpret a wide variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form while dealing with several abstract and concrete variables. COMPUTER SKILLS Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Power BI, including Power Query, DAX, data modeling, and the Power BI Service; Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, advanced formulas, and Power Pivot; SQL and relational database concepts; Microsoft 365, including SharePoint, Lists, Teams, and Power Automate; data integration using REST APIs; work management platforms such as Monday.com; process mapping and diagramming software such as Visio; and spreadsheet, presentation, and word processing software. Familiarity with Python or R, Power Apps, Microsoft Fabric, and Microsoft 365 GCC High preferred. OTHER QUALIFICATIONS Valid driver’s license required. COMPLIANCE, WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS The following information describes the general work environment and physical demands associated with this position. The statements below are representative of those an employee may encounter while performing the essential functions of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions. WORK ENVIRONMENT The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Work is primarily performed in an office environment and may also be performed in aircraft hangar and shop environments, where noise levels may be loud at times and personal protective equipment may be required. PHYSICAL DEMANDS The employee is frequently required to sit and use a computer for extended periods, and occasionally required to stand and walk, including on hangar and shop floors. The employee must occasionally lift and or move up to 25 pounds. Vision requirements may include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. EMPLOYMENT REQUIREMENTS Employment is contingent upon successful completion of required pre-employment screenings, which may include a background check and drug screening, in accordance with applicable laws and company policies. This position requires the ability to travel on short notice, as business needs dictate. EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY King Aerospace is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veteran/Disability

jobs.title: Associate Data Engineer, AI Studio
jobs.description: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Company Description As the world's leader in digital payments technology, Visa's mission is to connect the world through the most innovative, convenient, reliable, and secure payments network, enabling individuals, businesses, and economies to thrive. Our advanced global processing network, VisaNet, provides secure and reliable payments around the world, and is capable of handling more than 65,000 transaction messages a second. The company's dedication to innovation drives the rapid growth of connected commerce on any device and fuels the dream of a cashless future for everyone, everywhere. As the world moves from analog to digital, Visa is applying our brand, products, people, network, and scale to reshape the future of commerce. Job Description Visa AI Studio is Visa's AI operating system: a single platform for building, deploying, and operating predictive models, foundation models, and AI agents at global scale. It gives every team at Visa a common, self service way to train and experiment, build with generative AI, develop and run production AI agents, manage features and memory, and operate everything with governance and observability built in. Visa AI Studio is the foundation for how AI gets built across the company. This role is for a Data Engineer, with a strong development background, whose primary objective will be to extend our AI as a Service platform to the Public Cloud while enhancing, optimizing our existing codebase and development procedures, as well as developing new solutions. We are seeking for a strong tech leader and architect with a solid background in public cloud and AI/ML production systems. The ideal candidate will have a strong mix of hands-on technical knowledge and leadership skills, with the ability to contribute technical knowledge and grow leadership skills, supporting the team's progress toward our technical objectives, with guidance from senior engineers. They should be hands-on, knowledgeable about cloud technologies, business drivers, and emerging AI/ML trends, and experienced with AWS and GCP services. The role demands a proactive learner who can work through ambiguity with support, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and contribute to decisions. The candidate should possess strong interpersonal skills, excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to manage complex projects and deadlines. A problem-solving mindset and a hands-on approach are key to succeeding in this role. This role offers ample opportunities for learning and growth, and the chance to be part of delivering the next big thing for our AI as Services team. If you are experienced and passionate about cloud technology, AI, and machine learning, and are excited about making a significant impact, we would love to hear from you. This is a hybrid position based in Austin, TX, allowing alternating between remote and office work. Expectations are to be in-office at least two days a week, typically Mondays, Tuesdays and alternating Fridays, aiming for a 50% office presence based on business requirements. Essential Functions Design, build, and operate core components of AI Runtime Services: live model and agent serving, the runtime console, release management, and production reliability, so other teams can deploy and operate safely with minimal platform-team intervention. Drive development effort end-to-end for on-time delivery of high-quality solutions that meet requirements, align with the architectural vision, and comply with applicable standards, across all phases from design through production. Collaborate with Product Managers, Architects, Analysts, Software Engineers, and Project Managers to plan, document, and manage risks and issues to resolution; present technical solutions and status clearly in business terms. Embed governance, responsible AI, audit, and monitoring directly into the serving path, including drift, hallucination, and anomaly detection for agentic systems in production. Partner with the AI Engineering Platform, AI Context Platform, and AI Governance Platform teams to deliver a coherent, end-to-end platform experience. Develop and extend the AI agents and agentic workflows that run across AI Runtime Services, from automating platform operations to powering products like Visa Claw, so the platform's own capabilities keep advancing. Leverage AI coding agents and LLM-powered developer tools as part of your own workflow, treating AI-assisted engineering as a core skill to design, build, and ship platform capabilities faster. Coach and mentor junior team members, growing the team's talent pipeline. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree, OR 3+ years of relevant work experience. 1 or more years of hands-on experience delivering robust, scalable solutions on public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), preferably in an AI/ML production environment. Expertise in one or more of Golang, Java, Rust, C/C++, or Python, with strong systems and software engineering fundamentals, including distributed systems and API/SDK design. Preferred Qualifications Expertise in Advanced Python; professional cloud certifications. Basic understanding of core machine learning and deep learning concepts, and the ability to reason about a model or agent across its full lifecycle, from training through production deployment, monitoring, and retirement. Proven experience designing and developing data-driven, real-time and batch systems, with a deep understanding of the trade-offs across design, architectural, and integration patterns. Hands-on fluency with modern AI-assisted development (coding agents, copilots, LLM-based tooling) to accelerate day-to-day engineering work. Experience mentoring peers or interns, and contributing to technical design discussions within the team. Expertise in cloud architecture and service offerings, including core cloud services (compute, storage, databases, networking, AI/ML), AWS EKS, ElastiCache, and CloudWatch. Rust and/or C++ experience is highly desired for latency-sensitive serving components. Experience building internal developer platforms, SDKs, or self-service tooling used by other engineering or data science teams, such as a runtime console or similar self-serve capability. Information for US Applicants For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $86,500.00 to $ 134,400.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program. Work Hours Varies upon the needs of the department. Travel Requirements This position requires travel 5-10% of the time. Mental/Physical Requirements This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers. Visa is an EEO Employer Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Goodwill Central Texas is seeking a Data Engineer to design, build, and support the data pipelines, integrations, and data models that make trusted information available for reporting, analytics, and operational use. This role will work with business stakeholders, application owners, software developers, and data visualization professionals to connect data from enterprise systems and turn it into reliable, well-documented data products. Microsoft Fabric, Azure, and Power BI are important parts of Goodwill's evolving data environment. Candidates may bring experience from those technologies or from comparable cloud, data, integration, software development, or automation platforms. Success in this role requires strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to apply existing experience to new tools and technologies. Data Pipelines and Integration Design, build, test, and maintain data pipelines that ingest and transform data from enterprise applications, databases, APIs, files, cloud services, and external partners. Develop reliable batch, scheduled, incremental, or event-driven data flows using the approach appropriate to each source and business need. Integrate structured and semi-structured data, including relational data, JSON, CSV, Excel, and API payloads. Work with application owners, developers, and vendors to understand source systems, define mappings, manage dependencies, and resolve integration issues. Build reusable components and patterns that improve the consistency, maintainability, and speed of future data integrations. Data Platforms and Modeling Build and maintain data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Azure, and related technologies as Goodwill's data platform evolves. Organize and transform raw data into trusted, reusable structures for reporting, analytics, and operational use. Develop and maintain data models, transformation logic, metadata, and documentation that make data understandable and usable across the organization. Partner with data visualization professionals to provide reliable datasets and semantic models for Power BI reports, dashboards, and self-service analytics. Evaluate appropriate use of lakehouse, warehouse, relational, and other data-storage patterns based on business and technical requirements. Automation and Engineering Practices Apply software development and automation practices to data engineering, including source control, code review, testing, deployment, logging, and technical documentation. Use code, low-code tools, or a combination of approaches to automate data movement, transformation, validation, monitoring, and operational tasks. Build on experience with platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Databricks, AWS data services, Snowflake, Power Automate, Logic Apps, or comparable technologies. Contribute to shared engineering standards, reusable templates, naming conventions, and deployment practices. Participate in technical design reviews and help evaluate tools, services, and implementation options. Data Quality, Governance, and Reliability Implement validation, reconciliation, and data-quality controls that identify incomplete, inconsistent, duplicated, stale, or invalid data. Monitor pipelines and data processes, troubleshoot failures and performance issues, and implement corrective and preventive improvements. Maintain clear data lineage, mappings, schedules, ownership information, operational procedures, and support documentation. Apply appropriate security, privacy, access, retention, and governance requirements throughout the data lifecycle. Design solutions that are reliable, scalable, supportable, and cost-conscious. Business and Cross-Functional Collaboration Work with business stakeholders and subject-matter experts to understand processes, reporting needs, business rules, and measures of success. Translate business requirements into technical data designs, explaining options, dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs in clear language. Collaborate with data visualization, software development, infrastructure, security, and application teams to deliver complete solutions. Provide clear updates on progress, issues, data-quality concerns, and decisions requiring stakeholder input. Support knowledge transfer and help colleagues use data products effectively and responsibly. Continuous Improvement and Support Investigate data incidents and reporting discrepancies, identify root causes, and implement lasting solutions. Review pipeline performance, platform usage, and support trends to improve reliability, efficiency, and maintainability. Stay current with modern data engineering, integration, automation, and Microsoft Fabric capabilities, recommending practical improvements when they provide value. Participate in release planning, production support, and post-launch reviews for data solutions. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. Three or more years of experience in data engineering, data integration, software development, application integration, automation, business intelligence, or a related technical field. Experience building data pipelines, integrations, automated workflows, or software processes using at least one modern cloud or enterprise platform. Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational data and databases. Experience integrating data through APIs, databases, files, connectors, or other application interfaces. Experience with a scripting, programming, query, or automation language or tool, such as Python, PowerShell, SQL, Power Automate, or a comparable technology. Understanding of data modeling, transformation, quality, security, and governance principles. Ability to troubleshoot technical and data issues, document solutions, and communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Ability and willingness to apply experience from other platforms while developing proficiency in Microsoft Fabric, Azure, and Power BI technologies. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric capabilities such as OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, pipelines, notebooks, or semantic models. Experience with Azure data services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure SQL, Data Lake Storage, Databricks, or Logic Apps. Experience with comparable platforms or services such as AWS S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, Snowflake, or other cloud data technologies. Experience preparing governed datasets or semantic models for Power BI or another business-intelligence platform. Experience with Power Automate, Power Apps, or other low-code automation and integration tools. Experience with source control, automated testing, deployment pipelines, and development, test, and production environments. Experience integrating enterprise platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, HubSpot, ADP, SharePoint, or comparable systems. DP-700: Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate, or another relevant Microsoft, AWS, data engineering, analytics, or related technical certification. Experience in retail, workforce services, distributed operations, or nonprofit environments. Key Attributes Practical and curious problem solver Logical and structured thinker Collaborative and approachable partner Attentive to data quality and technical detail Comfortable learning new platforms and applying transferable experience Able to connect business needs with reliable technical solutions Committed to clear documentation and maintainable engineering practices Physical Requirements Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times. While performing the duties of this position, the employee may frequently be required to walk, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, talk, or hear. The position requires the ability to manage moderate levels of workplace stress. Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Equal Employment Opportunity Goodwill Central Texas is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Introduction A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. Your Role And Responsibilities Data Engineer embedded with the client's teams to design and deliver hands-on solutions on the AWS/Databricks platform. The role combines architecture and engineering, and you will build and prove solutions with the client. Work includes re-engineering legacy data workloads and supporting data migration from MySQL to Databricks Lakebase. Responsibilities Work onsite or embedded with client teams to understand business problems and turn them into working technical solutions. Design and build data pipelines and integrations using Fivetran, Databricks, and AWS services. Lead technical design and delivery for migrating a Tier-1 application from MySQL to Databricks Lakebase, including schema re-design, data migration, cutover, and validation. Integrate SAP data through SAP BTP and BDC Connect, non-SAP data, and design domain centric data products. Build prototypes and reference implementations, then work with the client to harden them for production. Support data and AI use cases, including integration with GCP-based ML/GenAI components. Establish engineering standards: CI/CD, testing, observability, security, and cost control. Coach client and delivery team members, and communicate status, risks, and design decisions to stakeholders. Design end-to-end data solutions across multiple platforms, applying industry standards and best practices to meet client needs. Lead the development of data platform architectures, including cognitive components and unstructured data technologies, annotation, and related data and analytics. Manage and maintain large data repositories, ensuring scalability and performance. Create data solutions on cloud-native platforms (AWS, with GCP for ML/GenAI), tailored to client requirements. Collaborate with clients to understand their needs and deliver customized data solutions that meet their business objectives. This job can be performed from anywhere in the US Required Technical And Professional Expertise Must be able to travel 4 days per week (mandatory). Databricks Certified Data Engineer or Machine Learning Professional. Advanced hands-on expertise in data engineering and solution architecture, with demonstrated ability to design and deliver complex data solutions. Strong hands-on expertise with Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow, Unity Catalog), AWS, SQL, and Python, including large-scale batch and streaming workloads. Experience with relational databases such as MySQL, database migration/re-engineering, Fivetran or similar ingestion/ELT technologies, and modern data-sharing patterns. Experience with Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, and other open table formats, including schema evolution, optimisation, and interoperability across engines. Hands-on experience designing scalable data platforms and pipelines using technologies such as Kafka, Amazon EventBridge, or Amazon SQS, along with Terraform and CI/CD practices. Preferred Technical And Professional Experience Experience with Databricks Lakebase or similar managed PostgreSQL/OLTP-on-lakehouse technologies. Knowledge of SAP BTP, BDC Connect, SAP extraction patterns, or SAP IS-U. Exposure to GCP ML/GenAI services and cloud-native solution design across AWS and GCP. Experience with Git-based version control and branching strategies for data workloads. Experience in the utilities or energy industry, with relevant Databricks and/or AWS certification.
